learning_objective: The learner can outline the end-to-end process for building an evaluation system, including creating guidelines, defining methods and data, annotating evaluation sets, and iterating based on results.

common_misconceptions.description: Believing that public benchmarks alone are sufficient to find the best model for a specific application.
Assuming that more evaluation data is always better without considering cost and reliability trade-offs.
Thinking that evaluation pipeline design is a one-time linear process rather than an iterative cycle.
